Name: Alexander the Coppersmith
Role: Opponent who did Paul much evil
Summary: Alexander the coppersmith did Paul much evil and greatly withstood his words, so that Paul warns Timothy to beware of him. He is listed separately from the Alexander of 1 Timothy, since the letters do not identify them as the same man.
KeyStory: Alexander the coppersmith did Paul much evil and greatly withstood his words, so that Paul warns Timothy to beware of him. He is listed separately from the Alexander of 1 Timothy, since the letters do not identify them as the same man.
LifeLesson: Opposition to the gospel is met with warning, not vengeance; the Lord will reward.
